    Lemma 5.2: object quotients have bricks #

    lem:deletion-brick (mesh-deformations.tex): "Among the objects outside Σ, choose X of least composition length. Every radical endomorphism of X factors through its proper image. Each indecomposable summand of that image has smaller length, belongs to D by image-closure, and therefore belongs to Σ. Hence the radical of End(X) becomes zero in the quotient. Its identity remains nonzero … Thus its quotient endomorphism ring is its residue division algebra." "By Proposition 2.10, this applies to C as ind(mod A₀)."

    We run this argument for C through the evaluation ev : add C ≃ mod A₀ (full faithfulness and essential surjectivity, Lemma 2.9 and Proposition 2.10): the length of X is dim ev(X), the image of ev(r) is ev(W) for a family W of smaller labels, and r factors through W.
